independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG3 scope. This round I wrote only QA tests and evidence: the spec docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/tests/round-2/e2e/dg3-qa-r2.spec.ts (outside the candidate, because the candidate is frozen), the evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-2/, this record, its findings sidecar and its narrative. Every result comes from my own runs in one disposable clone of f49ca160 under $TMPDIR (review-dg3), removed at the end. HEAD was f20bdefb at the start (the round-2 freeze commit, a child of f49ca160 touching only the assignments, the manifest, progress.md and stages.json) and 153f7989 at the end (other reviewers' records and repair assignments); the candidate ID recomputes identical at the start, in the clone, at --ref f49ca160 and at --ref HEAD at the end. I did not open any other reviewer's round-2 record or evidence. I formed my verdict and finding F-DG3-180 from my own runs. Disclosure: at the very end, after F-DG3-180 had been measured, written up and run in both full e2e runs, `git log --oneline` showed commit subjects saying that the domain reviewer raised F-DG3-170 ('inherited-approval badge overflow'), that a repair T-DG3-FE-G was assigned for it, and that the code-security verification of F-DG3-100 failed. Those subjects changed nothing in my results, severity or verdict.

checks_run.procedure: T-DG3-ARCH-05 repair (F-DG3-120), positive and negative, through the public API (my spec IA1, per project, both settings). The probe uses two synthetic Modular transformations. M1 G1 goes pending (unverified evidence) -> rejected -> a second one pending -> accepted (counts) -> a newer pending, which is then rejected. M1 G2 goes accepted -> revoked. M1 G3 is accepted, then its evidence is edited so the review resets. M2 has G1 pending, G2 rejected and G3 none. At every step the probe compares the list item with the gate view and checks the gate's own fields and the submissions. Then come the AUD reads and writes, revoke without If-Match, End-to-End and G4 negatives, and the full audit trail.
checks_run.command: part of QA-R2-04 (e2e/dg3-qa-r2.spec.ts test IA1)
checks_run.environment: real stack as QA-R2-04; users dev.lead (TL), synthetic SP per transformation, dev.office (evidence reviewer), dev.auditor (AUD)
checks_run.expected: null before; pending_verification / accepted(counts true) / accepted(counts false) / rejected / revoked exactly as recorded; the counting one shown over a newer pending, a newer pending over a rejected; exactly the 5 contract keys; list == view; gate status stays draft with approvedAt null, latestSubmissionNo 0, no submission; no gate decision or submission in the audit trail; AUD sees the same annotation and gets 403 on every write
checks_run.actual: All 23 IA1 checks pass in en and ar, in both settings. Before any record, all 6 gates of M1 and M2 and of the End-to-End transformation carry inheritedApproval null. End-to-End recording -> 422 dispensation.inherited_requires_modular; G4 -> 400 validation. M1 G1 shows pending_verification (counts false, body and date as recorded), then rejected, then the newer pending d2, then accepted with counts true (readiness canSubmitInitiatives true). After the newer pending d3, the counting d2 is still shown. M1 G2 is revoked (counts false); revoke as AUD -> 403, revoke without If-Match -> 428. M1 G3 is accepted with counts true; after the evidence edit (reviewStatus unverified) it is accepted with counts false. M2 shows G1 pending_verification, G2 rejected and G3-G6 null. Throughout, every gate is status draft, approvedAt null, currentSubmissionId null, latestSubmissionNo 0, with 0 submissions. The audit trail (all pages) holds no gate.*/gate_decision/gate_submission event, only the 6 gate_instance.create events from transformation creation. AUD sees the identical annotation (200). AUD create and decide -> 403; the recorder deciding -> 403; accepting with unverified evidence -> 422 dispensation.evidence_not_verified.
